title: BlackView Tab 18 Review | This 12" Helio G99 Tablet plays it all! | Switch, PS2, Gamecube emulation
summary: RetroBreeze reviews the 12-inch Blackview Tab 18 as a complete Helio G99 tablet, placing its brief PS2 result alongside screen ratios, native Android games, other emulators, battery, speakers and desktop features.

blocks.text: The twenty-nine-minute review makes PS2 one workload inside a broader device decision. Unboxing and Android games lead into screen-ratio discussion and a generation-by-generation emulator pass; PS2 appears before 3DS, Vita and Switch. Later chapters cover the Helio G99, streaming, general performance, speakers, battery, Android 13, desktop mode and split screen. That structure prevents one successful clip from defining the entire tablet and lets users judge whether a large inexpensive display is useful beyond emulation.

The launch discount expired in November 2023, and the purchase link pays commission. Only a short PS2 chapter is available within a multi-system review, with no emulator build, game list, renderer, resolution or sustained thermal log in the notes. Claims such as “plays it all” are promotional language, not catalogue coverage. Use the device overview for form factor and feature context, then seek current title-level evidence before purchasing. Helio G99 results cannot be transferred automatically to newer firmware or other tablets sharing the chip.
